notes.page_content: Six-column handwritten list headed Notes 1, 5, 7, 15, 20, 23, with main letters A B C D E E, years, titles, crossed and live subdivision markers, translations, footer abbreviations, arrows and edge traces.
notes.authors_own_uncertainty: Two question-mark glyphs are written at the left: a dark ? beside the upper opposed-arrow cluster and a pale ? beneath the first crossed subdivision. No verbal expression of authorial uncertainty occurs in the supplied page text.
notes.page_numbering: Archive numeral 12 is pencilled sideways at the lower right and appears only in a TeX comment. No manuscript page-number macro is added.
notes.page_counts: The written numeric headings are transcribed as Notes 1, 5, 7, 15, 20, 23; no page-count label is supplied.
notes.mathematics_led_decisions: There is no mathematical computation in this reading. Numeral/alphabet decisions use their local strokes. No theorem, reconstruction or repair is supplied.
notes.crossed_predecessor_method: Each crossed interior was judged on its own crop; no glyph was recovered from the live subdivision beneath it.
notes.graphical_scope: All paths are direct approximations of inspected visible components. Black/gray values distinguish relative darkness. Role, hand and surface origin remain unassigned for detached and pale components. Additional annotation text occurs only in comments/report, not as manuscript prose.
crop_boundary_limits: Crop 04 shows the adjoining pale upper hook entering its left edge; that hook was read in half a and is preserved in L01.
Crop 02 meets a few upper gray continuations at its top edge; no second word is supplied from them.
Crop 23 includes the darkening G07 and its right endpoint; the long rule continues through the left crop boundary and was read in half b.
notes.context_boundary: The assigned notes contain no later-sheet tail to include. The notation snapshot was contextual and each sign on this page was read afresh.
notes.validation: Structural source checks only. No OCR, text recognition, PDF text layer, external source, browser, compiler, renderer, installation or delegation was used.

brief_feedback: The supplied kind vocabulary has no dedicated table value. I used drawing for the six-column layout with text nodes and rule paths, retaining each textual inventory item.

For pale doubled forms with readable glyphs but no isolated strike, I qualified cancelled/live state locally and kept the source deletion annotation in an invisible dimensional box, with no extra visible horizontal strike.
Uniform C array rules obscure the uneven line positions and the uncertainty of long pale vertical traces. The return gives explicit graphical paths and states their unassigned surface origin.
